result.summary: Found several issues: broken delivery fee display showing NaN, truncated restaurant name, and incomplete category chips row styling.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows delivery fee as '€NaN delivery', indicating a null/undefined price was formatted as a number.
issues.suggestion: Handle missing or invalid delivery fee values with a fallback (e.g. 'Free', '—', or hide the fee) and ensure the API always returns a valid number before formatting.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated mid-word under the third Fastest near you card, cutting off the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, use ellipsis with full name on a second line, or ensure card width and typography fit typical restaurant names without clipping.

issues.description: Category filter chips row ends abruptly with a partial empty/white chip on the right, looking unfinished next to Healthy.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal padding and chip spacing so the last fully intended chip doesn't leave a stray partial pill, or fade the edge consistently with the carousel pattern.
